name: orchestrator-accept
about: A product question is escalated with a recommendation (docs/phases/08-orchestrator.md, piece 2). After the batch window the @orchestrator app posts it in the item's thread, mentioning the approver, with [Accept] [Other…]. Someone else's Accept is refused; the approver's records the recommendation as their answer, marked as accepted, and the buttons give way to 'Accepted by you.'

body.text: the agent asks whether the timer rounds up or down
body.recommendation: round down, as the oven's own display does
body.reason: it matches what people see on the oven
